lightingIsotropy.method: Native-resolution luminance-gradient orientation histogram over non-water land; uniform is the 36-bin baseline.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Visual area estimate over non-water land, separating level bench and shelf tops from cliff faces, talus, and broken gullies.

waterMask.note: Connected east-sea classification includes surf, wash, ripples, reflections, and the southern inflow; enclosed transparent pixels are dry stacks and dry built neighbour pixels, not omitted water.

crown.method: Full-frame manual outer-foliage-width census at native 1254 px of all visible crowns, including every sapling, overlapping north-west-gully crown, isolated crown, and clipped edge crown; median scaled to 2560 px.

visualReview.authority: Owner review required; mechanical checks do not establish visual acceptance.
knownRisks: The edit introduced scattered conifers beyond the sheltered western gullies.
Several long east-cliff column groups remain more regular than the weathered-irregular coast rule calls for.
The existing built span visible at the east edge came from the edit target; the generated fill did not deliberately author rail infrastructure.
